component.name: Beef's Brewhouse
component.summary: Build decks and track your trading card collection

description.p: A deckbuilder and collection tracker for Riftbound, One Piece Card Game, Pokémon TCG, Magic: The Gathering and Yu-Gi-Oh!, with every card's picture and market price.

ul.li: Build decks with each game's zones and copy limits, and check them against format rules and ban lists
Track the cards you own, with foil and condition, binders, a trade list and a wishlist
See deck and collection values, and get told when a wishlist card drops to your target price
Draw sample hands and work out the odds of drawing the cards you need
Import decklists, and export them as text, a link or a picture

description.p: Card data and pictures are downloaded from each game's public card database. Beef's Brewhouse is a fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the games' publishers.

screenshot.caption: A deck with its card images, value and legality
Building a deck: the card browser, deck stats and the deck list
Drawing sample hands to practice a deck
Tracking the cards you own and what they are worth

description.p: Adds Riftbound printings missing from the card data: Nexus Night and tournament promos, Signature cards, runes and Radiance's first cards.
